title: A time intelligence filter on the date key removes a filter on another column of the Date table

source.quote: this ALL statement is automatically applied when you apply a filter over a column of Date type that is the primary key in a relationship
source.supports: a filter on the date key removes the filters on the other columns of the Date table

source.quote: Returns a set of dates in the year up to the last date visible in the filter context.

derivation: The outer filter is on Date[YearMonth], not on Date[Date]. DATESYTD returns January 1 to March 31, 2024. Date[Date] is a date column and the key of the relationship from Sales, so the filter on it also removes the filter on YearMonth: Jan 300 + Feb 700 + Mar 500 = 1500. If the YearMonth filter stayed, the result would be March only, 500.
notes: The model does not mark Date as a date table; the behaviour comes from Date[Date] being a dateTime column on the one side of a relationship.
